title: Question and answer frame
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Common vocabulary: numbers, colours, clothes and shapes
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 12 (Question and answer frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 12: How many? Counting things with كَمْ. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Asking how many
points: How many books do you have?

panels.title: Answering: 11 to 20
points: عِنْدِي أَحَدَ عَشَرَ قَلَمًا: I have 11 pens
عِنْدِي عِشْرُونَ كِتَابًا: I have 20 books

parts.text: Start with عِنْدِي (I have). 6 is between 3 and 10: سِتَّةُ. Then the plural noun: أَقْلَامٍ.

questions.q: Ask a girl how many books she has.
Core: Count three kinds of things on your desk and write a question and answer for each (portal response box).
questions.a: For example: كَمْ قَلَمًا عِنْدَكَ؟ عِنْدِي أَرْبَعَةُ أَقْلَامٍ.

questions.q: Extend: Translate: I have 8 books. I have 12 pens.
questions.a: عِنْدِي ثَمَانِيَةُ كُتُبٍ. عِنْدِي اثْنَا عَشَرَ قَلَمًا.

questions.q: Stretch: Use a feminine noun: I have three cars (سَيَّارَة).
questions.a: عِنْدِي ثَلَاثُ سَيَّارَاتٍ (the number loses ة with a feminine noun)

questions.q: Which is correct for 'I have four books'?
questions.a: B) عِنْدِي أَرْبَعَةُ كُتُبٍ. After 3 to 10 the noun is plural: كُتُبٍ.

questions.q: What does كَمْ mean? A) how many B) where C) who
Big question: ask and answer 'how many pens?' in Arabic.
questions.a: كَمْ قَلَمًا عِنْدَكَ؟ عِنْدِي خَمْسَةُ أَقْلَامٍ.
